text:
Emmalee: Quick sync - Acme wants to move to pilot. They attached a security questionnaire and redlined subprocessor clause. Need legal + security + finance to confirm PO flow and signer list.
chris_legal: I reviewed the SQ and their subprocessor ask is for a full list + 30-day notice before changes. We should provide current subprocessor list and agree to notice, but push back on contractual obligation to list every future subprocessor. Propose: "Provider will provide Customer with a current list of subprocessors and notify of material changes with reasonable advance notice."
hana_security: That works. They also flagged SOC2 scope and SAML SSO for admin portal. For pilot we can host in us-east-1 and provide SAML metadata, but full SSO integration is post-pilot. Note that SAML onboarding needs a designated technical contact and a test IdP.
devon_finance: PO policy: we require PO referenced to the orderform ID before activation. Net30 okay. Need W9 attached to PO; payment via ACH after countersign. What's the PO amount?
Emmalee: PO will be $36,000 (30-day Dedicated pilot + support). Signers: primary ceo.ops@acmehealth.com, backup procure@acmehealth.com. DocuSign preferred. Orderform ID: RF-24-ACME-SMPL.
sam_solutions: Onboarding note: please provide signer mapping in JSON so we can pre-provision routes: {"primary":"ceo.ops@acmehealth.com","backup":"procure@acmehealth.com","billing":"acctspay@acmehealth.com"}. Also confirm region us-east-1.
chris_legal: I'll add subprocessor language and a one-time remote compliance review clause for the pilot (30 days' notice, Customer's cost). For SLA they requested 99.8% for pilot; we can offer timeboxed elevated SLA with credits capped to pilot fees.
devon_finance: Net30 accepted if PO references RF-24-ACME-SMPL and includes PO# + W9. Billing contact?
Emmalee: Billing contact acctspay@acmehealth.com. I'll ask them to send PO and W9 now.
docsign_bot: DocuSign envelope prepared and sent to ceo.ops@acmehealth.com, procure@acmehealth.com. Envelope ID env-0xdef456.
emmalee: I sent checklist to Acme: PO referencing RF-24-ACME-SMPL, W9 attached, signed DocuSign, and SAML test contact for post-pilot SSO work.
docsign_bot: Envelope env-0xdef456 signed by ceo.ops@acmehealth.com at 2024-09-10T11:22:05Z.
chris_legal: Countersigned MSA + Pilot Addendum ready. I'll attach redline and finalize after PO + W9 verification.
devon_finance: Received PO#ACME-PO-20240910 and W9. Preparing invoice and will include ACH routing after countersign.
emmalee: Great - onboarding will start once finance confirms invoice posted. Closing after countersign and invoice sent. :white_check_mark:
